en.title: Trade value of imports and exports
en.description: Under the general trade system, the goods entering and leaving the country (including Taiwan, Penghu, Kinmen, and Matsu) are limited. The export goods are calculated based on the Free On Board (F.O.B.) price, and the import goods are calculated based on the Cost, Insurance, and Freight (C.I.F.) price, including exports, imports, re-exports, and re-imports. Unit: NT million.

resources.description: Under the general trade system, the limitation applies to the import and export of goods into and out of the country (including Taiwan, Penghu, Kinmen, and Matsu). The export goods are calculated based on the Free on Board (F.O.B.) price, and the import goods are calculated based on the Cost, Insurance, and Freight (C.I.F.) price, including export, import, re-export, and re-import.
